metadata.title: Quantum Entanglement, Non-Local Bell Correlations, and No-Signaling from the Universal Path-Contour Master-Functional in Unified Phase Dynamics
metadata.description:
We present a step-by-step deductive derivation of bipartite and multipartite quantum entanglement, non-local Bell–CHSH correlations, Tsirelson's upper bound, relativistic no-signaling, and macroscopic gravitational Bell decay directly from the universal Feynman path-contour master-functional Ψ[Σ] in Unified Phase Dynamics (UPD) by H. Pavliuk.

Key analytical and numerical results:

  • Topological Non-Separability: Entangled branches emerging from a shared creation vertex x0 form a single non-factorizable closed contour γAB = γA ∪ γB in loop space ℱΣ over 𝒢 = U(1)Y × SU(2)L × SU(3)c × Spin(3,1).
  • Exact Correlators & CHSH Saturation: Spinor projection yields EUPD(a,b) = −a·b, photonic Malus law cos 2(α−β), SUPD = 2√2 ≈ 2.828427 > 2, and GHZ–Mermin violation ⟨M3⟩ = 4 > 2.
  • Tsirelson Bound & No-Signaling: Commutator algebra and OS2 reflection positivity prove |S| ≤ 2√2 (excluding PR boxes) and exact trace-marginalized no-signaling (ΔPB = 5.55 × 10−17) compatible with luminal cT ≡ c.
  • Experimentum Crucis 1 Bell Crossover: While ℰ(□) at ΛUPD = 1.2 TeV preserves optical Bell tests within 10−47, gravitational phase dephasing enforces Seff(t) = 2√2 exp(−t/τG) ≤ 2 for t > 3.47 ms at Mcrit = 3.13 × 1012 amu.
